title: pm/skills: write the SQL-first rule down — a capability the memory or mongo driver cannot run is refused there, never served by a slower path kept for parity
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. In the triage seat session on 2026-11-15, verbatim: 「有的功能如果Mongo内存不支持，那就不需要支持，首先保sql,应该用最高性能的方案，而不能为了兼容而兼容」. It generalises the 2026-08-05 freeze anchored on #5499 (driver-memory and driver-mongodb: no new investment; memory to be replaced by SQLite in-memory). Today the rule lives only on cards (#5499, #33619, #33626), so a design or a review can still choose a driver-agnostic slow path. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

把一条设计原则写进规则文件：SQL 驱动（含 Turso）优先，用性能最高的方案；内存和 Mongo 驱动做不到的能力就在那里明确拒绝，不为了兼容去保留一条更慢的通用路径。今天这条只散在几张卡上，设计和复审时仍可能选「各驱动都能跑但慢」的方案（例如跨对象过滤先查 id 再 `IN`、1000 上限）。

## What lands

1. **AGENTS.md** (governed; Tier H, maintainer merge): one rule near the engine and driver guidance. A capability is designed for SQL drivers first, at the highest-performing shape (push-down: JOIN or semi-join, aggregates in the database). Drivers that cannot run it refuse with a stable code. A slower driver-agnostic path is never built only for parity. Cite #5499 and this card.
2. **`pm-dispatch` decision analysis** (`references/decision-analysis.md`): under 项目长远合理性, an option that slows SQL to keep memory/mongo parity counts against itself.
3. **Contract review** (`references/contract-review.md`): a reviewer flags a new id-materialisation or in-app join on a path SQL can push down, unless the PR names why.
4. **Skills** (authoring guidance that mentions drivers): state that memory and mongo may refuse capabilities that SQL serves.

## Grade

p2 (a rule that steers every design; tooling-class).
